SRC-214:R001.text: Do not presume the previous executor caused the incident.

SRC-214:R002.text: Do not modify unrelated historical code or reopen completed tickets without new evidence.

SRC-214:R005.text: Do not interrupt currently admissible work.

SRC-214:R006.text: Identify the introducing or last materially changing commit and recover author, timestamp, ticket, ownership and verification evidence where it exists; distinguish Git authors from verified executor identity.
